theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → ((∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∃ (lpush : ∀ (N N' k : ℕ), (Euclid N → Euclid N') → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k), (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → lpush N N k (fun x => x) X = X) ∧ (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact Y.support → Y.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ → lpush N N' k F (X - Y) = lpush N N' k F X - lpush N N' k F Y) ∧ (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → EqOn F G X.support → lpush N N' k F X = lpush N N' k G X) ∧ (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → (lpush N N' k F X).mass ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * X.mass ∧ (lpush N N' k F X).support ⊆ F '' X.support) ∧ (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → (lpush N N' (k + 1) F X).boundary = lpush N N' k F X.boundary) ∧ (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → ∃ Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N', (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Fs j)) ∧ (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Fs j)) ∧ TendstoUniformly Fs F atTop ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k, ∃ ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ j, ∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x)) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => X (ηs j)) atTop (𝓝 (lpush N N' k F X ω))) ∧ ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (Λ' : ℝ) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N') (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k) (ηs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Fs j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ X.support, ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x‖ ≤ Λ') → TendstoUniformlyOn Fs F atTop X.support → (∀ j, ∃ W : Set (Euclid N), IsOpen W ∧ X.support ⊆ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (ηs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x)) → Tendsto (fun j => X (ηs j)) atTop (𝓝 (lpush N N' k F X ω))
